state_semantics.WATCH: A measured setup is forming and one or more explicit conditions remain.
state_semantics.CONFIRMED: Either a named closed-candle technical trigger, explicitly technical-only, or a canonical PREQUAL_PASS/SCORE_PASS.
state_semantics.TRADEABLE: Canonical PRESEND_PASS only; not an order submission or fill.
state_semantics.INVALIDATED: A closed 5m reference candle touched the fixed stop/invalidation level.
state_semantics.EXPIRED: The bounded opportunity lifetime elapsed before a terminal target/stop outcome.
state_semantics.COMPLETED: The shadow-reference scenario touched TP3 and was removed from active monitoring; not an executed fill or realized profit.
